name: Ba Be food guide
summary: Five-colour sticky rice is the plate with a photograph. Grilled lake fish, sour shrimp, forest bamboo shoot, upland sticky rice, roast suckling pig, bamboo-tube rice, pork hung over the fire, and kitchen-hung sausage are named at the houses and are not pictured. The photograph is the dish in Sơn La. Stall prices are check on arrival. The plants that dye the rice are check on arrival.
